commentary.text: 90+7' Jeremie Pignard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Total attempts – 4:11.

90+2' 1 - 2 A perfect lofted pass from Junior Mwanga finds Arouna Sangante (Le Havre), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Donovan Leon had no chance of stopping that. 1:2.
90+2' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+1' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner but it's cleared.

89' Substitution. Clement Akpa leaves the pitch and is replaced by Theo Bair (Auxerre).
88' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) picks up an injury.
87' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jeremie Pignard signals.

80' We are about to witness a substitution. Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) is replacing Fredrik Oppegard.

79' A raking crossfield pass from Loic Nego (Le Havre) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
78' Le Havre are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
76' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Jeremie Pignard due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Andre Ayew (Le Havre) and his team.
75' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

72' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

70' Substitution. Fode Ballo-Toure did his best and is replaced by Timothee Pembele (Le Havre).
70' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Le Havre win a corner kick.
69' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) commits a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul. Le Havre win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
68' A pass by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
66' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
65' The free kick from long range, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

62' 1 - 0 Goal! Gaetan Perrin tees up Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
62' Auxerre are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
60' The corner kick from Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
59' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
58' Loic Nego (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
57' Great ball in from Issa Soumare. Andre Ayew (Le Havre) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
54' Loic Nego (Le Havre) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Yassine Kechta, but Donovan Leon displays great awareness to stop him.
53' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
52' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
52' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Le Havre get a corner.
50' Paul Joly (Auxerre) tries to find Sinaly Diomande, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
49' 2:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
47' Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The second half gets underway.

45+4' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Donovan Leon is equal to it and makes an easy save.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
43' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Koka walks off the pitch to be replaced by Andre Ayew (Le Havre).
42' Koka (Le Havre) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
41' Koka (Le Havre) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
40' Koka (Le Havre) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Loic Nego (Le Havre) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Donovan Leon intercepts the ball.

35' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Koka (Le Havre) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Donovan Leon pulls off a comfortable save. Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
34' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Donovan Leon comes off his line to intercept.
33' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:0.
31' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
29' Paul Joly (Auxerre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
28' Le Havre couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Donovan Leon (Auxerre) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
27' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Clement Akpa (Auxerre) for his blatant foul.
26' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
24' Koka (Le Havre) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Issa Soumare, but Donovan Leon displays great awareness to stop him.
23' Jeremie Pignard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
21' Paul Joly (Auxerre) brings his opponent down. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
18' The free kick from long range, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' Looks like Fode Ballo-Toure (Le Havre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

15' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Mathieu Gorgelin, who pulls off a comfortable save!
14' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
13' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) sends a long ball forward to Paul Joly, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
10' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) sends a long ball in, but Donovan Leon comfortably gathers the ball.
